## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T14:56Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** objectstack's hourly Spec Shape Gate compiles this repo's `types` test project against objectstack `main`'s spec. With #12666's row gone (PR #12678), these four pins are its next red. A repeating red gate is p1 under the maintainer's rule 「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. The body's `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23846` is satisfied (merged at 2026-10-16T11:15Z). The installed next.2 lacks `kind`, so the pins must hold against both the installed spec and objectstack `main`'s. Lane note: `packages/types` is this repo's `domain:spec` stream, whose seat (#10217) is vacant, so it goes to `domain:ui`, as #12666 and #12670 did.

Claim: PM loop round 4 (`priority:p1`, `target:v18`; the next red row of objectstack's hourly Spec Shape Gate, triage grade `6218222181`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12711-select-option-kind`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12711` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface:
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts`: the four type pins at `:130`, `:138`, `:150` and `:157`, plus the runtime pair `rejectsUndeclaredKeyOnFormFace` / `acceptsEveryDeclaredKeyOnFormFace`, re-read against a spec that accepts `kind`;
- a `.changeset/12711-*.md` only if objectui's changeset rules ask for one on a test-only change.

The pins must hold against BOTH the installed `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2` (no `kind`) and objectstack `main`'s spec (with `kind`). That is what the hourly gate compiles.

Outside the surface:
- Any edit to `PRE_CONVERGENCE_*` (the file's own rule);
- any `as any`;
- any change to the `SelectOption` / `SelectOptionMetadata` faces in `packages/types/src`. If the form face must leave `kind` out, that is reported as an open question, not built here;
- Targets 2–4 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23809 (the record path, kanban and the Studio column).

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the path: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: test pins only. No published type, prop, export, schema read or pack key changes; the faces already derive the spec's keys by reference.
Responsibility: n/a — the pins went false through an upstream spec widening (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23846), not an objectui landing
Thread-read: 6218222181
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `96fa4b9bc4`. `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23846` is satisfied (merged 2026-10-16T11:15Z, per triage `6218222181`). No open PR touches the test file or `SelectOption`. objectui#12670 (another seat, in flight) is in `packages/types`, but on the list-view node face, not this file. NOT governed (`check-governed-merges --test`, 0 of 1).
